description: Department of Cooperative Development - Cancellation of Registration of the Cooperative Societies of Central Province
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the cancellation of registrations for multiple cooperative societies (thrift/credit, school, producer societies) by the Commissioner of Co-operative Development. This falls under business/commercial matters, specifically the regulation and dissolution of registered commercial entities, making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6). It does not involve government personnel/structure, land, legal acts, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
